title: What OUTSIDE can detect
intro: The authoritative, code-backed inventory of every discovery collector, enrichment provider and detector in the deterministic pipeline. It describes the product's abilities — never this instance's configured keys — and is kept honest by a test that fails if a capability drifts from what a real scan produces.
discoveryCtDescription: Enumerates hostnames from public TLS certificate logs (crt.sh).
discoveryDnsDescription: Resolves candidate hostnames and infrastructure records over DoH (Cloudflare).
discoveryHttpDescription: Observes response headers, redirects and certificate metadata over an IP-pinned, DNS-rebinding-safe TLS connection. Verified targets only.
discoveryRdapDescription: Reads registrar and expiry from RDAP for the root domain.
passivednsSecuritytrailsDescription: Adds subdomains from SecurityTrails that never appeared on a public certificate; every hostname is validated as a real subdomain of the target.
passivednsShodanDescription: Adds subdomains from Shodan's DNS dataset, validated as real subdomains of the target.
censysServicesDescription: Reports non-web services (SSH, databases, RDP, brokers) observed on resolved public IPs, and flags exposed datastores/admin surfaces.
classifySignalsDescription: Classifies assets (web, API, auth, mail) and derives shadow-asset, non-production and auth-surface exposure signals.
mailSecurityDescription: Detects missing SPF/DMARC policy on the mail surface.
misconfigHeadersDescription: Flags absent baseline HTTP security headers from the observed response.
misconfigRedirectDescription: Flags a redirect that downgrades HTTPS to plain HTTP.
misconfigDomainDescription: Flags an expiring or lapsed root-domain registration (takeover/outage risk).
vulnCorrelationDescription: Correlates disclosed technology versions against a curated CVE/EOL set, enriched with live CISA KEV status and FIRST.org EPSS scores.
intelIprepDescription: Attaches adverse reputation for resolved public IPs.
intelBreachDescription: Reports public data breaches associated with the organization domain.
intelGreynoiseDescription: Classifies resolved IPs as malicious internet-wide scanners vs benign.
intelVirustotalDescription: Aggregates security-vendor reputation verdicts for the domain.
twinConcentrationDescription: Builds the Digital Twin dependency graph and flags shared nodes (CDN, nameserver, IP, technology) that a large share of the surface depends on.
guardianChangeDescription: Detects new, returning, disappearing, drifting and priority-changed surface between scans.
